business_domains.notes: stripe_payments.py owns Connect Express account onboarding (bank/CLABE payout target) via embedded AccountSession (@stripe/connect-js on the frontend, no hosted-URL redirect). automatedPayments.py owns SetupIntent-based card saving and the daily off-session installment charge (APScheduler job 'daily_charge_due' at 07:00 UTC in main.py), which on success Transfers the collected amount into the lender's Connected Account and credits their clientWallets row. walletBalance.py exposes reserve/release/debit/credit actions used by loan disbursement (acceptProposal -> reserveWallet -> Stripe Transfer -> debitWallet) and on-demand withdrawal (POST /stripe/withdraw -> stripe.Payout.create). onboardingReminders.py is a daily scan (APScheduler job 'daily_onboarding_reminders' at 15:00 UTC) that reminds a client once via push notification for any incomplete step (QR, documents, verification, contract, payment account). disbursement.py is a dormant/legacy manual-wire-transfer alternative to the Stripe path — not called by the frontend, kept for reference only, do not extend it.

Face liveness verification (4-direction challenge + blink detection, consistency/match distance thresholds) runs entirely client-side via @vladmandic/face-api in faceLiveness.ts — Azure Face API/Face-Liveness-With-Verify was removed from the backend and is no longer used anywhere. document_intelligence.py calls Azure AI Document Intelligence (prebuilt ID model, poll-based analyze) for INE/ID field extraction; Tesseract.js (idOcr.ts) is a client-side fallback OCR. signatureMatching.py does OpenCV (cv2) contour comparison between the ID's signature crop and the contract signature capture. geocoding.py is a thin httpx reverse-geocoding proxy used by the presence-capture step (latitude/longitude -> address).
